Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

balancesample 0.0.0.9000

  • First draft of the package: balanced_vfold_cv(), balanced_initial_split(), balance_check(), and four balancing methods ("anticlust", "twinning", "rerandomize", "interaction").

  • Workflows with a postprocessor that must be trained (for example, a tailor calibration) now work with tune::fit_resamples(), tune::tune_grid(), and tune::last_fit(). The inner calibration split is balanced with the same settings as the outer split. This needs rsample 1.3.1 or later.

  • labels() of repeated folds now combines the repeat and fold IDs, as it does for rsample::vfold_cv().

  • New “Get started” article that walks through a full tidymodels workflow.

  • balanced_vfold_cv() and balanced_initial_split() now reject unknown arguments. If you pass strata, the error tells you to use exact.

Developed by Jeffrey M. Girard.
